-- Reads one name confined to `notes`. Returns None when the file is
-- missing or unreadable, or when the name tries to leave `notes`.
read_in_notes(name: str) -> str? uses fs =
  ex read_in_notes("../secret") == None
  ex read_in_notes("/etc/passwd") == None
  -- Defence in depth: reject absolute paths, parent references and
  -- backslashes before the confined fs is even consulted.
  let parts = name.split("/")
  if parts[0] == "" or name.split("..").len() > 1 or name.split("\\").len() > 1
    return None
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return None
    return text

-- Text of the first name in `names` that can be read from `notes`,
-- or "" when none can.
first_readable(names: List[str]) -> str uses fs =
  ex first_readable([]) == ""
  ex first_readable(["../secret"]) == ""
  for n in names
    let r = read_in_notes(n)
    if r != None
      return r else ""
  ""
